title: Correct sprint-status.yaml's false 'done' marking on 10 Epic-19 stories — confirmed unimplemented cleanup in story 19-10

evidence.quote: 18 — Onboarding & Track Management Overhaul | Superseded by E24–E26; all stories now Canceled
DNI-166 | 18.1: Extract Reusable Add Track Flow (הוספת מסלול) | Canceled

why: sprint-status.yaml marks 10 of the 11 Epic-19 story files in this batch (19-2, 19-2b, 19-3, 19-4, 19-5, 19-6, 19-7, 19-10, 19-11, 19-12) 'done', but every one of those files itself shows 0 checked tasks and a template Dev Agent Record ('_To be filled during implementation_') rather than the file-list/completion-notes pattern every Epic-18 and story 19-1/16-1 file has. For story 19-10 this is not just a stale doc: its AC-4 required deleting TextDownloadService, the text_download_status_dao.dart/table, and cloud_content_providers.dart — all three are still present and actively wired into live Riverpod providers today (cloud_content_providers.dart even carries a 'Retained for potential future use' comment). The identically-named story 1-1 shows the same pattern for Epic 1 (file says ready-for-dev/blank Dev Agent Record; tracker says done) and additionally the on-disk filename doesn't match the slug sprint-status.yaml and linear-mapping.yaml reference (`...with-architecture-foundations` vs `...and-directory-structure`), so a script matching by slug would 404 on it. Anyone treating sprint-status.yaml as ground truth (the BMAD dev-story workflow explicitly does) has no way to discover this outstanding cleanup work.
recommendation: For each flagged story, either back-fill the Status header and Dev Agent Record with real completion evidence matching the shipped code, or correct sprint-status.yaml to the true status. Start with 19-10: verify its AC-4 against the live tree (confirmed still-present: TextDownloadService, text_download_status_dao.dart/table, cloud_content_providers.dart) and either finish the deletions or record why they're intentionally retained, then fix its sprint-status.yaml entry. Add a cheap grep-diff checker under tool/ that flags any docs/stories/implementation/*.md whose sprint-status.yaml entry is `done` while its own `Status:` header is `ready-for-dev` (uncaught today because nothing runs the reconciliation this batch performed manually).
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 10 flagged Epic-19 story files has a Status header and Dev Agent Record consistent with actual repo state, or sprint-status.yaml is corrected to match.

Story 19-10's AC-4 is re-verified against learning_tracker/lib/: TextDownloadService, text_download_status_dao.dart/table, and cloud_content_providers.dart are either removed or their retention is explicitly justified, and sprint-status.yaml is updated accordingly.
A Rule-0 checker (tool/ script, runnable in CI) fails when a story file's own Status header disagrees with sprint-status.yaml's status for the same story key.
mergedFrom: Reconcile docs/status/sprint-status.yaml (and linear-mapping.yaml) with Epic 18's cancellation in Linear
